raw.query: SELECT run_id, sla_metric, p50_ms, p90_ms, p99_ms, max_ms, n_requests FROM v_pool_latency WHERE run_id IN ('srcbuild:llm_head2k_aic_src','srcbuild:llm_head2k_poly_src') ORDER BY run_id, sla_metric
raw.observed: srcbuild:llm_head2k_aic_src (ttft p99=307.36ms, p50=38.82ms, p90=120.36ms) vs srcbuild:llm_head2k_poly_src (ttft p99=248.46ms, p50=46.03ms, p90=110.37ms); itl p99 aic=22.64ms vs poly=29.70ms — both runs is_current=true, superseded_by=null
raw.evidence: Two current, non-superseded srcbuild runs (aic_src = aiconfigurator/calibrated, poly_src = polynomial) on identical head2k workload expose paired timing metrics, so a delta is computable (e.g. ttft p99 aic 307.36 vs poly 248.46 ms, Δ≈58.9 ms; itl p99 poly 29.70 vs aic 22.64 ms, Δ≈7.06 ms).
